name: scramble-reveal
description: 文字解码式逐字揭秘动效工具
tagline: Decode the mystery, word by word.
interaction: Text starts as scrambled cipher characters and progressively decodes to reveal the real content, character by character. The user can trigger the unscramble effect on scroll, hover, or click, creating a cinematic
experience ideal for headings, code reveals, and storytelling moments.
